root_cause: validate_output_directory_safety() only checked leaf directory name, allowing nested subdirectories (e.g. stage_8_1_oof/sub) and relative path traversals (..) to bypass historical directory protection
remediation: Enforced resolved path normalization, checked all raw and resolved path components against FORBIDDEN_HISTORICAL_DIRS, and verified is_relative_to() against forbidden roots

root_cause: Root safety check was executed inside each experiment iteration on output_dir, causing EXP-0 completed artifacts to falsely block EXP-1 with non-empty directory error
remediation: Separated orchestrator-level root check (is_root=True, executed once at start) from per-experiment child check (is_root=False on exp_dir), and enabled root reuse

root_cause: verify_manifest_provenance_and_coverage() did not verify raw OOF predictions SHA against referenced file, and lacked versioned schema checks for Stage 9.7+ manifests
remediation: Emitted provenance schema 2.0 with mandatory 64-char raw_oof_sha256, validated raw OOF file content hash, verified clean OOF ID ancestors, and enforced 100% split coverage and sum=1.0

root_cause: compute_dataset_inventory_fingerprint() previously relied on file metadata in some paths and did not hash validation split contents when data_yaml was passed
remediation: Implemented full SHA-256 content hashing of all image and label bytes, label pairing verification, and included validation split contents via data_yaml_path

root_cause: Dataset integrity validator risked treating empty 0-byte label files as corrupt, whereas in YOLO convention 0-byte labels represent valid background images without objects
remediation: Explicitly recognized 0-byte label files as valid background images without lesions, reporting them accurately in dataset summaries

root_cause: resolve_data_yaml_split() failed with TypeError when data.yaml split entry was formatted as a YAML list of directories rather than a string
remediation: Enhanced resolver to recursively handle string directory, string .txt image list, and lists of directories/txt files

root_cause: load_annotations referenced undefined variable image_files instead of images_to_load, causing NameError during preflight execution
remediation: Corrected variable reference to images_to_load and verified against canonical train split

root_cause: target_imgsz hardcoded fallback to 640 when hyp.imgsz was missing, causing image dimension mismatches in collation when dataset was initialized with non-640 resolutions
remediation: Fallback to self.imgsz when hyp.imgsz is not specified, guaranteeing consistent tensor shapes across cropped and uncropped batch items
